line.follow:
Thank you for adding us as a friend. 
This account offers features to help you communicate with hospital staff throughout your pregnancy and up through childbirth. 

First, please use the button below to register your information and link your account to the hospital. 

*We are unable to reply to individual messages.
line.register: Click the button below to register your profile.
line.registerStaff: Click the button below to register your hospital information.
line.howto: Click here to learn how to use the app.
line.UserOrStaff: Are you a general user or a hospital staff member?

link.desc: Register your basic information, hospitals you visit or plan to deliver at, and important contacts.

bp.desc:
Enter your preferences for the kind of birth you want.
You can use this as a reference when creating the birth plan to submit to the hospital.
bp.info1:
You can also save your progress and continue later.
Please note that not all preferences can always be accommodated.
bp.info2: Grayed-out items are not supported at your planned delivery hospital.

8.development: The heart begins to beat, and the early arms and legs start to form.

9.development: The shape of the body gradually becomes more defined.

10.development: Fingers form, and the baby starts to look more like a baby.

11.development: Facial features begin to take shape.

12.development: The basic structure of the body is almost complete.

13.development: The baby begins practicing swallowing amniotic fluid.

14.development: The baby begins to move the body a little.

18.development: The baby begins to respond to sounds.

19.development: A protective coating forms on the skin.

20.development: You may begin to feel the baby move.

26.development: The baby begins to open the eyes.

28.development: The body begins to fill out.

30.development: The baby begins to move more powerfully.

31.development: A rhythm of sleeping and waking begins to appear.

32.development: The head is more often positioned downwards.

34.development: The baby is getting ready to drink breast milk.

36.development: The body's functions are becoming ready.

37.development: This is the time when the baby may be born at any point.

38.development: The baby is almost fully developed.

39.development: The baby is ready for birth.

40.development: This is the time when the baby is born.

10.text: The thought of harming myself has occurred to me.

01.text: I have been able to laugh and see the funny side of things.
01.o1: As much as I always could.

02.text: I have looked forward with enjoyment to things.
02.o1: As much as I ever did.
02.o2: Rather less than I used to.
02.o3: Definitely less than I used to.

03.text: I have blamed myself unnecessarily when things went wrong.

04.text: I have been anxious or worried for no good reason.

05.text: I have felt scared or panicky for no good reason.

06.text: Things have been getting on top of me.
06.o1: Yes, most of the time I haven't been able to cope at all.
06.o2: Yes, sometimes I haven't been coping as well as usual.
06.o3: No, most of the time I have coped quite well.
06.o4: No, I have been coping as well as ever.

07.text: I have been so unhappy that I have had difficulty sleeping.

08.text: I have felt sad or miserable.

09.text: I have been so unhappy that I have been crying.
